name: Heat spike (tarpaulin / closed van)
description: 30 C baseline with a 2 h spike to 42 C at hour 3 (e.g. under a tarpaulin or in a closed van), then back to 30 C. 42 C is below the 45 C hard threshold.
expected_story: No hard breach (42 C < 45 C) but each spike hour counts for ~2.3x the decay of a 30 C hour under the Q10 law; status stays 'fresh' at hour 8 while the thermal-load number jumps. Shows the engine accelerating on spikes without over-reacting.
